ground_truth.title: Product & Integrations Sync (Hinglish Code-Switched)
ground_truth.reference_transcript: Rohit: Haan team, let's start today's sync. Neha, mobile upload screen ka kya update hai? Neha: Mobile browser par upload karte waqt jab connection unstable hota hai, upload drop ho raha hai. Maine test kiya hai aur TUS resumable upload ka retry mechanism tune karna padega. Aman: Haan Rohit, main is issue ko own karta hoon. Main automatic retry logic aur offline indicator implement kar doonga by Friday, October 30th. Rohit: Bohot badhiya Aman. Aur Neha, what about the Jira and Google Calendar settings page? Neha: Jira per-user OAuth and webhook notification flow ready hai, bas documentation pending hai. Main Tuesday, November 3rd tak complete guide and test credentials publish kar doongi. Rohit: Perfect. Now regarding decisions: We decide to make TUS resumable upload the mandatory default for all mobile recordings. Sab agree karte hain? Aman: Haan, bilkul agreed. Neha: Agreed. Rohit: And we also decide to limit maximum email reminders to two notifications per overdue action item taaki users ko spam na feel ho.

action_items.description: Implement automatic retry logic and offline network indicator for mobile uploads
Publish complete guide and test credentials for Jira per-user OAuth setup

decisions.decision: Make TUS resumable upload the mandatory default protocol for mobile browser recordings
decisions.rationale: Prevents failed audio uploads on unstable cellular network connections

decisions.decision: Cap overdue action item email reminders at a maximum of two notifications
decisions.rationale: Prevents alert fatigue and spam for team members

ground_truth.reference_summary: In this Hinglish product sync, Rohit, Neha, and Aman reviewed mobile stability and integration setup. Aman will implement auto-retry logic for mobile uploads by October 30. Neha will publish documentation for Jira per-user OAuth by November 3. The team decided to enforce TUS resumable upload as the default on mobile devices and capped overdue reminder emails at two per task.
